note: Approved asset sources for the ModVerse Asset Acquisition Pipeline (npm run assets:acquire). Only sources whose files download without a login and whose licence allows commercial use are automated; everything else is reported as a manual step.

manualSources.name: Innerscene male base mesh (CC0)
manualSources.reason: The page states CC0 and free, but the GLB is served through the site's interactive download button; no direct file URL is published.

manualSources.name: Innerscene female base mesh (CC0)
manualSources.reason: Same as the male base mesh.

manualSources.name: Sketchfab downloadable models
manualSources.reason: The search API is public, but the download endpoint answers 401 without a logged-in Sketchfab API token. Filter to CC0 / CC-BY, download glTF, and drop the folder in the destination.

manualSources.name: CLO-SET CONNECT free assets
manualSources.reason: Requires a CLO account; files are ZPRJ/ZPAC (CLO / Marvelous Designer project files with sewing patterns) that need CLO or Marvelous Designer to export OBJ/GLB. Check each item's licence: many are free for use inside CLO only.

manualSources.name: All Project Files — Marvelous Designer
manualSources.reason: Download links go through file-hosting pages and items carry no clear commercial licence. Verify the licence per item before use.

manualSources.name: CGTrader free models
manualSources.reason: Login required to download; 'Royalty Free' licences forbid redistributing the source files, which a public repository would do. Suitable only if the files are kept in private storage.

manualSources.name: Free3D clothing
manualSources.reason: The site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403) and most items are 'personal use only'.

manualSources.name: 3D Garments
manualSources.reason: Host was unreachable from the build environment (connection refused by the proxy).

manualSources.name: Virtual Fashion Lab, Meshy, ArtStation Marketplace, Open3DModel
manualSources.reason: Account, paid or unclear licences; Meshy items are AI-generated meshes, which the brief excludes.
